request:
Read and follow the project documentation.

Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Mossback Tuskling".

## Creative brief

- Core concept: A forest boar charger that pressures players out of safe positions.
- Body and silhouette: Compact wedge-shaped body, short legs, lowered head, and broad shoulders.
- Signature features: Moss-covered back, curved wooden tusks, and a leaf-shaped tail.
- Palette and materials: Bark brown, moss green, pale ivory, and rough organic textures.
- Movement personality: Heavy and stubborn until it suddenly accelerates.
- Attack concept: Telegraphs a straight charge, then scatters seed projectiles sideways when it stops.
- Directional details: The right tusk is shorter, and the largest moss patch remains on its left shoulder.
- Avoid: Domestic pig appearance, oversized boss proportions, realistic fur rendering.

Resolve all production details from the current repository contracts and complete the candidate in Intake-ready staging
